HexKagune 1.0.43 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 51). Testing build.

- **Grab is a parry now:** only your first swing at the Kaneki after his tendril sets out counts, and it breaks the grab only in the last 8 ticks before it holds you; swing too early and you get grabbed.
- **Grab cue:** a bell and a white glint in front of you mark the moment the break window opens.
- **Swings away don't cost you:** a swing aimed away from the Kaneki (at a mob beside you, say) isn't judged.
- **Swatting costs your hit:** an M1 that swats shards (still up to 3) deals no damage itself, so blocking Ayato means not attacking.
